Name: Froststar11's Butterflies
Author: froststar11
Description:
[s]This file replaces the entire critters.xnb. It is not compatible with any other critter reskins (frogs, rabbits, birds, etc.) I haven't learned how to just replace certain coordinates with Content Patcher yet.

[/s][b][u]2/16/19: [/u][/b]
I learned how to utilize the Action:EditImage finally! Now you won't have any conflicts with mods that modify critters.xnb unless they also change the butterfly sprites. 

[b][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/b]:

Unzip into your mods folder.

Downloads.Description: My art skills VASTLY improved so I decided to redo this mod. The butterflies look much nicer now :) Also, bug fixes.

Manifest.Description: A slightly more colorful reskin of the butterflies.
